rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for toothpaste, including fluoride toothpaste.

example.english: I had no toothpaste when brushing my teeth this morning, so I had to make do with water.
example.traditional: 我朝早刷牙冇牙膏，唯有用清水頂住先。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 caat3 ngaa4 mou5 ngaa4 gou1 wai4 jau5 jung6 cing1 seoi2 ding2 zyu6 sin1
